reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Palmer! Very caring and sweet British lady, lectures interesting enough. Exams were not hard if you studied the exam reviews and prepared before, case study assignment was not hard. The quizzes are very self explanatory and she posts all the coarse materials. Attendance was mandatory but capped at 5 points from your total grade.

palmer is super nice and definitely cares about what she teaches! it's a tough course but certainly not impossible. it's a pretty heavy work load: several readings per week that you're quizzed on, and 3 writing based exams, including one case study, each worth 25% of your grade. make sure you go to class and do the readings!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: I really liked Dr. Palmer, and could have gotten an A if I put in more effort. She cares so much about what she teaches. Keep up with the readings so you're not struggling on tests.

Almost impossible to make an A when 75% of your grade is handwritten exams graded by the TA who is a tough grader. You are expected to write as a professional consultant when this is your first time taking the class. Even when you know all the answers you will still be counted off for not writing it how they would.

Dr. Palmer is very knowledgeable in the world of environmental ethics. If you want to get into the nitty gitty of env. ethics, she is a great teacher to take. That being said prepare to WORK in this class. Readings, quizzes, essays, public speaking. This class will make you justify any/all opinions.

Hard to get above a 90, but if you go beyond what's talked about in lecture on the project yu'll do well. Sitting at a high B before the final, but ended up with an A. Make sure to participate. The exam & final are both fair; review her slides very thoroughly. She is helpful in office hours and provides good analysis on her slides for reference.

Dr. Palmer is amazing!!! I found her lectures to be super interesting. There are many readings, but she explains main ideas during lecture. I loved that she taught different angles to ethical discussions and encouraged new ideas from students. Attendance was mandatory but points off capped at -5% of total grade.

Dr. Palmer is an expert in her field and it shows! However, her lectures just aren't that engaging in my opinion. There are many LONG philosophical readings that you have to understand in order to do well on the exams and tests. The subject matter is very interesting however.

To this day, the other students and I have no idea what her opinions are on controversial issues. She was completely unbiased and open to anything we talked about in discussions. She's a tough grader when it comes to the group project and the two essays, but if you ask, she will review your essay before the deadline and give feedback.

this class consists of weekly quizzes (which are timed and pretty hard), a midterm, final, and case study. you really need to know the material to do well on all of these things so make study guides and flash cards for each topic, and even the readings!!

Dr. Palmer is a gem! She's an amazing lecturer, kind, and absolutely hilarious. Honors graded by participation, two short papers, a midterm, a group project, and a final paper. She assigns readings before lectures also, which help for participation. Default grades seem to be high B/low A. Learned so much, truly can't recommend anyone better!

Dr. Palmer definitely knows what she's talking about and in-class discussions we had were extremely interesting. The class is heavily based on two exams that emphasize the readings which were often dense. There are lots of ways to boost your grade through Packback, attendance, and the case study, which was an easy A. She's such a nice professor too

Lectures were boring but informative, mandatory attendance, lecture quiz every week, PackBack twice a week, short and long readings each week. Midterm was based mainly on readings so it was kinda hard to remember every argument. A paper that was not too bad but grades tough. Readings were hard to remember but lecture stuff was easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This professor was such a great teacher, truly one of the best one's I've had! She is full of knowledge and is so passionate about what she teaches. This class is pretty intense, but I have learned so much and so glad she was the one teaching it. It will be a challenging class, but it's all worth it!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Palmer is an awesome professor if you are vaguely interested in the class. She's extremely nice and her "lectures" are more of discussions. Also actually interesting. Assuming you pay attention, the grading isn't bad either. My only complaint is that it her default grade seems to be a 90. It's easy to get that. Hard to get much higher
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Stuggling with a B right now and I am going into the final needing and 80 to keep it. Honestly, this class was cool and the teacher is awesome. The exams are what hurt me since the first one was half mc and an essay. The final is 8 FRQ and one essay or case study. If you take her DO THE READINGS!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Really knows her stuff and her lectures are interesting. Make sure to do the reading before class, because she makes you earn participation points and gives pop quizzes over the reading.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Not the biggest fan for how this class is set up. Her slides arent straight to the point and her lectures can be long and boring. Overall a great person but this class can be hard If you struggle with with ethical arguments and philosophical viewpoints.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I would highly recommend Professor Palmer. She's super enthusiastic about what she teaches and wants students to learn. If you go to class, take notes and do the readings, it shouldn't be hard to do well.

I LOVE PROF PALMER! I took this class by accident and it ended up being my favorite one this semester. She is so sweet and goofy and really wants to help her students learn. She takes attendance but if you have a good reason to miss she will excuse and is very understanding. PHIL111 is so interesting and her expectations are clear. TAKE HER!!!!

Definitely take this professor! She is a ton of fun, has really interesting lectures, and makes the class enjoyable. Have to do the readings, but the quizzes aren't bad. Exams are fine if you know the material.

Professor Palmer is an amazing teacher. Her lectures are interesting and she has a great sense of humor. Her class consists of some basic reading quizzes, a short paper or two, and 2 exams. The exams are fairly easy as long as you know the concepts. There isn't a book for this class but she posts all the readings online. Take her if you can!

Really liked this class. The material was interesting and she really encourages discussion, which makes the lecture more enjoyable. Also not hard to make a good grade in. Overall, she was very helpful and knowledgeable.
